title: LG ThinQ Washer Cycle Water Usage Leaderboard
dataSources: LG ThinQ washer cycles (`thinq:washer`), LG ThinQ dryer cycles (`thinq:dryer`), Home Connect dishwasher runs (`homeconnect:dishwasher`), and ecobee HVAC runtime (`ecobee:thermostat`).
app: LG ThinQ washer and dryer telemetry, Home Connect dishwasher data, and ecobee HVAC runtime exported into Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=thinq:washer water_liters=*
| stats sum(water_liters) as total_value, avg(water_liters) as avg_value by program_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks program name values by total and average water usage across LG ThinQ washer cycle events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `water_liters` values for each LG ThinQ washer cycle event and review total and average water usage by program name.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total water usage.
grandmaExplanation: It compares which program name shows the biggest water usage numbers in your LG ThinQ washer cycle data.
